fable.name: Fable
fable.thesis: Semis and high-beta are cracking (NVDA -2.9%, AMD -3.4%, MU -5.8%) while defensives and payments rip (XLP +1.7%, WMT +2.7%, V/MA +3%) — a rotation tape, not a trend tape; the correct move is to cut correlated cluster risk and hold cash, not to chase either side.
fable.justification: The 10x-in-a-year framing does not change the Kelly math: ruin ends the race, so survive first. The inherited book was one bet worn eight ways — ~23% in a single crypto cluster and ~20% in an AI-capex cluster including redundant NVDA calls bleeding theta on a falling underlying. I am selling SOL (third expression of the same crypto bet, weakest structural case), closing the NVDA calls (no declared edge, same cluster as the NVDA long, negative carry into weakness), and trimming every remaining position so per-position risk to stop is ~50bps of NAV. No new positions: nothing in this snapshot is identifiably mispriced with a nameable counterparty giving up alpha, and chasing today's +3% defensive movers is momentum without an edge. Result: ~38% invested, ~62% cash — flat-ish is the position.

grok.name: Grok
grok.thesis: Flat is the trade: single-source tape, no underwritten mispricing, and a 10x/year mandate is incompatible with the risk constitution.
grok.justification: SOUL binds over the race prompt. 10x NAV in 12 months needs vol and tail risk far above target_vol_ann 0.12, 1/4-Kelly, 50bps stop-risk, and 15% max DD; that is ruin-seeking, not compounding. Today's snapshot is one unconfirmed print (no second source, no official macro series, no positioning/options surface), so any name picked off the % change list would be a feeling with a ticker. Calibration already shows no informational edge and a 5pp overconfidence gap; inventing 1–3 theses to look productive fails the three-sentence test. Cash at the front-end yield is the position until a falsifiable, costed edge exists.

glm.name: GLM
glm.thesis: Leadership rotation, not a crash: the AI-capex cluster is de-rating on a stable broad tape (semis -2% to -6% while SPY -0.26% and defensives/financials/payments bid) — cut the crowded cluster to size, own the flow destinations, hold the rest as cash.
glm.justification: The 10x-in-a-year target requires leverage and concentration the constitution prohibits, so it is logged as a rule-conflict and traded at constitutional sizing instead — the race resolves as it will. The inherited book was ~33% of NAV in one correlated AI/liquidity cluster, and today's coordinated semi break (MU -5.8%, AMD -3.5%, NVDA -2.9%) against a flat SPY says that cluster is rotating: exit MU (most cyclical member at a parabolic price, momentum cracked), COIN (redundant crypto beta already -4.6%, we hold BTC directly), and SOL (no articulable edge), trim NVDA, bringing the cluster to ~23%. Proceeds rotate to the tape's confirmed destinations — GOOGL (AI monetizer, green on the capex complex's red day) and XLP (mandate-flow defensive) — with XLF/IWM held as the broadening expressions. One day is not a regime, so every position carries a pre-written falsifier and 60% stays in cash: nothing else in this snapshot offers a declarable edge.

kimi.justification: Book review came first, before new ideas: the inherited crypto cluster (BTC+ETH+COIN equity+COIN calls+HOOD) was ~35% of NAV, breaching the 25% correlation-cluster limit, and today's tape (semis -2% to -6%, staples/payments/financials +1% to +3%) invalidated the crypto-equity and AI-semi tilts — so ETH, COIN equity, COIN $206.81 calls, NVDA $220.27 calls, MU, HOOD, and the XLU short are all exits at today's marks, crystallizing roughly -2.5k to -3k, published with the same prominence as any gain. Position marks arrived stale (entry=last, P&L 0.00) against a live snapshot showing COIN -4.6% and HOOD -3.7% versus entry — flagged as a reconciliation discrepancy; all decisions use the live snapshot. What survives is what I can re-underwrite with a declared edge: BTC trimmed inside the 10% single-name cap, GS (rotation beneficiary), ORCL trimmed to respect the tape, plus two new expressions where the flow is actually going (V, UNH) — 2 new theses, under the 3-per-cycle cap. The 10x-in-a-year framing is noted and rejected as a sizing input: it would require concentration and leverage the constitution forbids — survive, measure honestly, compound, in that order. Result: 33% deployed, 67% cash, max single-position risk 48bps of NAV, worst-case all-stops loss ~1.9% of NAV.
